title: Hostel facilities
summary: Sports kit, TV room, gym, computer room and common room in every hostel.

posts.md:
Every hostel at IIT Madras provides a variety of common facilities for residents to support recreation, fitness, academics, and social interaction.

## Sports Equipment

Hostels maintain sports equipment that students can borrow and use.

Typical equipment includes:

- Cricket Kit
- Badminton Rackets
- Volleyball
- Football
- Table Tennis Bats
- Tennis Rackets

> Availability may vary slightly between hostels.

## TV Room

A common television room where residents can:

- Watch sports matches
- Follow major events
- Enjoy movies and entertainment
- Gather during important broadcasts

## Gym Room

Most hostels have a gym equipped with basic fitness equipment for residents.

Facilities generally include:

- Cardio equipment
- Strength training equipment
- Free weights
- Workout benches

## Computer Room

A shared computer room for academic and personal use.

Students commonly use it for:

- Assignments
- Programming
- Internet access
- Printing (where available)

## Common Room

The common room is a shared recreational space where students can:

- Relax with friends
- Hold informal discussions
- Play indoor games
- Organize small hostel activities
- Watch events together
**Did you know?**

Many hostel facilities are maintained by the **Hostel Council**, with different secretaries looking after sports equipment, technical facilities, and common recreational spaces.
